name: Piroker
description:
About This Game

Dive into an 8-player PVP strategy game that fuses poker and roguelike auto battlers. Draft your crew of pirates, trigger explosive chain reactions with poker hands, and outlast the competition in chaotic naval battles. In this 8-player free-for-all, luck isn't enough—you need cold calculation to rule the Seven Seas! Will you be the last crew standing?

Go Big or Go Under!

We’ve turned poker rules into pure combat. Your cards aren't just numbers; they are the keys to unleashing your crew's insane powers. Assemble a "Pair," a "Straight," or a "Full House" build to ignite your cannons and fire upon rival ships. Earn gold, buy powerful relics, and read your opponents' formations. In these rough waters, you must seize every unfair advantage to survive.

Battle Royale on the High Seas

It's not just cards... it's a Battle Royale!

  • Ever-Changing Warfare: Every shop reroll, every relic choice, and every "Mutant Fish" you catch can turn a ship full of holes into an unsinkable juggernaut.

  • Arena Mode (Async PvP): No time for a live game? No problem. No queues here. Play at your own pace — Face off against the "ghost fleets" of global players in unexpected duels anytime.

  • Duel your Friends (Real-Time Lobby): Want to see who the real King of the Table is? Invite friends to a private room for a joyous battle of wits and betrayal. Be calculating, or bluff your way to victory and earn those bragging rights.

No Gunpowder Smoke, Just Pure Chaos

  • Utilize a series of "illegal" tactics: recruit notorious pirates, capture cursed deep-sea fish, and play legendary cheat hands.

  • 100+ "Treasure" Skills: All pirates draw power from the same deck, creating hundreds of unique playing styles.

  • 60+ Pirate Heroes: Each captain offers a unique starting strategy and economy modifier.

  • Limitless Build Variety: Want to combine a "High-Card Sniper" build with a "Flush Bomber" strategy? The possibilities are endless!

  • 40+ Exotic Fish: These special "treasures" provide permanent, game-breaking buffs offering even more strategic choices.

Build Your Strategy

Immerse yourself in Piroker's distinct nautical world. Let the accordion melodies and roaring cannons surround you—sit back and enter the ultimate state of strategic flow.

  • Global Server: Compete against captains from around the world in competitive matchmaking for the ultimate prize, the Pirate King's throne.

  • Analyze your strategy: Use detailed on-screen stats to study your best win-rate lineups and review every brilliant play!

  • Complete the Collection: Unlock new pirates, skins, and achievements with every run to fill your treasure map.
short_desc: Poker turned into pirate mayhem. Build powerful relics, discover unique builds, and adapt your tactics to dominate the Seven Seas.
